title: Things
description: A listing of things in Nested Clone.

^.*$.description: An entry for a thing, keyed by its ID.

children.description: A catalog of the potential children of this entry.

predicates.description: A set of circumstances that must be met in order to generate this child.

items.description: A parent that must occur before "universe". A "!" specifies that this must NOT be a parent before "universe"

amount.description: A specific number of these things. Overwritten by "range" property if present.

range.description: A range describing how many of this child should be generated. Inclusive.

chance.description: The chance for this child to be generated at all

label.description: A list of labels to choose from randomly. If unspecified, the ID is used instead.

labelGenerator.description: The name of a function in nameGenerators.ts from which to generate a name

imagePath.description: A path to an icon to use, starting at docs/images. If unspecified, uses docs/images/${id}.png

inheritsFrom.description: A list of IDs of other things that this thing should inherit its children from.

description.description: A short description of the thing
